title: Commons RNG restores an integer sequence and its cached booleans
summary: A never-saved recipient rejected the parent checkpoint and kept its original continuation. The merged recipient produced the donor’s next ten integers. After restoring the cached third-bit position, the fresh and 19-draw recipients matched all 35 booleans and the following integer (−1705591924).

change.description: The checkpoint carries the length of its serialized delegate.

notes: The donor and recipient checkpoints belong to the same revision. The independent reference extracts low-order bits from java.util.Random.nextInt(). The historical JDK 8 supplies both the application and the class-loading records.
